title: Clocks
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: Wall-clock sponsor rotation and countdowns to an absolute deadline, with HH:MM unchanged.
checks: Node tests over the clock and rotation runtimes with a fake clock
brief.notes: Touches no src/output/ code, so it can start before the live-publishing run's phase 4 lands. Read runs/obs-scenes.md in NoaCG/noacg-private (clone it into docs/private as .agent-workflows/cloud-delegate.md says) for the owner's live windows and the run's private context; copy nothing from it into public text. Nothing that touches playout (src/output/, src/control/, src/components/home/, api/, supabase/) lands inside an owner live window or landing freeze listed there; the coordinator holds the stamp until the window ends. Make no change that risks reliable playout: with the OBS scenes switch off, everything behaves as today (AC-5). Rename nothing persisted (src/model/AGENTS.md). Phases touching src/output/ build on the live-publishing run's landed output changes; merge origin/main right before landing and never work around its design. A migration only when no production is live and no landing freeze holds (supabase/AGENTS.md quiet window). Every check the run can do, it does itself; OBS hardware results come only from the owner phases and are never counted as passed by a builder. A behaviour choice the spec does not settle goes to the owner as one question.
